notes: The set is synthetic and repository-authored; it is not sampled from production traffic.
Calibration cases select an answerability threshold. Holdout cases report the primary gate metrics.
Refusal and conflict labels express expected downstream behavior; this retrieval harness only verifies whether required evidence was retrieved.
